instructions.GITHUB: Open organization Settings > Webhooks > Add webhook. Use the callback URL, JSON content type, and the same secret. Select the workflow, issue, pull request, and security events you want to monitor. Organization owner access is required.
instructions.FORGEJO: Open organization Settings > Webhooks and add a Forgejo webhook with the callback URL, JSON content type, and the same secret. Select the supported repository events you want to monitor.
instructions.GITEA: Open organization Settings > Webhooks and add a Gitea webhook with the callback URL, JSON content type, and the same secret. Select the supported repository events you want to monitor.
instructions.GITLAB: Open group Settings > Webhooks. Use the callback URL and the same signing secret or secret token, depending on your GitLab version. Select pipeline, job, issue, and merge request events as needed. All tracked projects in this group and its subgroups are covered.
